name: Wheat — Area harvested
description: Total area harvested for wheat in 1000 hectares, from FAOSTAT QCL domain (item 0015, element 5312). Leading indicator for global food supply; sharp year-on-year contractions are early warning signals for wheat-importing country instability.

name: Wheat — Production
description: Total wheat production in tonnes, from FAOSTAT QCL domain (item 0015, element 5510). Supply-side complement to area harvested; yield shocks drive export restrictions and food price crises with documented geopolitical cascades.

name: Rice, paddy — Production
description: Total paddy rice production in tonnes, from FAOSTAT QCL domain (item 0027, element 5510). Primary caloric staple for over 3 billion people; production shortfalls in Asia are a leading indicator for social unrest and refugee movements.

name: Maize — Production
description: Total maize (corn) production in tonnes, from FAOSTAT QCL domain (item 0056, element 5510). Dual-use staple for human food and animal feed; production volatility affects meat prices globally and is a lagging indicator of drought stress.

name: Wheat — Yield
description: Wheat yield in hectograms per hectare (hg/ha), from FAOSTAT QCL domain (item 0015, element 5419). Measures productivity per unit land; yield stagnation or decline signals soil degradation, climate stress, or input scarcity — all geopolitically destabilising.

name: Arable land — Area
description: Total arable land area in 1000 hectares, from FAOSTAT RL domain (item 6620, element 5110). Structural measure of food production capacity; long-run decline indicates land degradation or urbanisation and constrains future production ceilings.

name: Cropland — Area
description: Total cropland area in 1000 hectares (arable land plus permanent crops), from FAOSTAT RL domain (item 6650, element 5110). Broader than arable land; changes reflect agricultural land conversion, a key driver of food-security and environmental risk.

name: Permanent meadows and pastures — Area
description: Total area of permanent meadows and pastures in 1000 hectares, from FAOSTAT RL domain (item 6655, element 5110). Proxy for livestock carrying capacity; rapid loss indicates desertification or land conversion and correlates with pastoral-conflict events.

name: Fertilizers — Nitrogen (N), Agricultural Use
description: Agricultural use of nitrogen fertilizer in tonnes of nutrient, from FAOSTAT RFN domain (item 3102, element 5157). Critical input indicator; sudden drops signal economic collapse, sanctions, or supply disruptions, presaging harvest failures 1–2 seasons ahead.

name: Fertilizers — Phosphate (P2O5), Agricultural Use
description: Agricultural use of phosphate fertilizer (P2O5) in tonnes of nutrient, from FAOSTAT RFN domain (item 3103, element 5157). Non-substitutable plant nutrient; import dependency on a handful of exporting countries makes this a geopolitical chokepoint indicator.

name: Average dietary energy supply adequacy
description: Average dietary energy supply as a percentage of average dietary energy requirement (%), from FAOSTAT FS domain (item 21010, element 6121). Macro-level food availability signal; values below 100% indicate structural caloric deficits and elevated famine risk.

name: Prevalence of undernourishment
description: Share of population with insufficient caloric intake (%), from FAOSTAT FS domain (item 21016, element 6121); published as 3-year rolling averages. SDG 2.1.1 indicator; high or rising prevalence is a confirmed leading indicator for internal conflict and refugee outflows.

name: Cereal import dependency ratio
description: Net cereal imports as a percentage of domestic cereal supply available for food (%), from FAOSTAT FS domain (item 21035, element 6121). Countries above 25% are structurally exposed to global price spikes and export bans — a leading geopolitical vulnerability metric.

name: Prevalence of severe food insecurity (FIES)
description: Share of population experiencing severe food insecurity based on the Food Insecurity Experience Scale (%), from FAOSTAT FS domain (item 21043, element 6121). Experience-based complement to caloric measures; rising trends precede social unrest by 6–18 months.

name: Depth of food deficit
description: Average kcal per person per day below the minimum dietary energy requirement among the undernourished population (kcal/capita/day), from FAOSTAT FS domain (item 21033, element 6121). Intensity measure that distinguishes shallow from severe undernourishment; critical for famine early warning.

name: Food supply — Dietary energy (kcal/capita/day)
description: Total food energy available for human consumption in kcal per capita per day across all commodities, from FAOSTAT FBS domain (item 2901 grand total, element 664). Country-level national food availability benchmark; complements PoU by providing absolute supply levels without modelling assumptions.

name: Food supply — Protein (g/capita/day)
description: Total protein available for human consumption in grams per capita per day across all commodities, from FAOSTAT FBS domain (item 2901 grand total, element 674). Dietary quality signal; protein deficit is linked to child stunting and reduced economic productivity, relevant to long-run political stability.

name: Cereals — Export value
description: Total export value of cereals in thousand USD, from FAOSTAT TCL domain (item 0079 cereals aggregate, element 5910). Trade-flow indicator capturing cereal export revenue; sudden drops signal export bans, sanctions, or production collapses that ripple into food-importing country stability.

name: Cereals — Import quantity
description: Total import volume of cereals in tonnes, from FAOSTAT TCL domain (item 0079 cereals aggregate, element 5610). Demand-side trade flow; spikes reveal emergency restocking after domestic shortfalls; combined with export value it flags bilateral trade disruptions relevant to recipe pattern matching.

name: Fertilizers — Potash (K2O), Agricultural Use
description: Agricultural use of potash fertilizer (K2O) in tonnes of nutrient, from FAOSTAT RFN domain (item 3104, element 5157). Highly concentrated global supply (Belarus/Russia/Canada); sanctions or trade disruptions directly constrain agricultural output and serve as a leading geopolitical stress indicator.
